<cite ref="Gittin 68a:2">Ib. 68ᵃ</cite> <he>אוכמא בחיורא</he> a black spot on a white skin. Pl. masc. <he>אוּכָּמִין</he>, <he>אוּכָּמֵי</he>, <he>אוּכָּמַיָּא</he>, <he>אוּכְמַיָּא</he>.

<cite ref="Chullin 46b:10">Ḥull. 46ᵇ</cite> <he>א׳ א׳</he> covered with black spots.—Fem. <he>אֻכָּמָתָא</he> <cite ref="Shabbat 129a:18">Sabb. 129ᵃ</cite>.
